meta.name: safe-debug
meta.description: Rigor Debug / Rigor Audit skill for deep learning research work. Use when the user pastes a traceback, terminal error, CUDA OOM, checkpoint load failure, shape mismatch, NaN loss symptom, or training failure and wants conservative diagnosis before any patching, with debug fixes clearly separated from research contributions. Do not use for broad refactoring, speculative adaptation, automatic exploratory patching, or general repository familiarization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把训练报错粘进来,先给出稳妥的成因判断,再给出与实验改动分开的修复方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果训练跑着跑着就报错或崩掉,却不想乱改代码。
copy.tagline_en: Paste training errors, get conservative root-cause diagnosis before patching
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your training run crashes and you want a careful fix that leaves research code alone

howto.what: 粘贴报错后，它会先保守诊断、缩小根因，默认不改代码；要修复时只提最小补丁并需你明确同意。产出 debug_outputs/DIAGNOSIS.md、PATCH_PLAN.md、status.json。
howto.when: 当你粘贴 traceback、终端报错或 CUDA OOM 等失败现象，想先做诊断、拿到最小补丁建议再改代码时触发。不做大范围重构或纯代码改写。

say.text: 我贴一段 traceback，先帮我诊断，不要改代码。
say.note: 输出 DIAGNOSIS.md，代码保持不动。

say.text: 这个 CUDA OOM 的根因是什么？只给最小修复方案。
say.note: 生成 PATCH_PLAN.md，改码前需你同意。

say.text: 这个 shape mismatch 修复算研究改动吗？
say.note: 说明改动是否影响实验可比性。

howto.what_en: It diagnoses first after you paste an error, narrowing the root cause without changing code by default; any fix is a minimal patch needing your explicit approval. It writes debug_outputs/DIAGNOSIS.md and PATCH_PLAN.md, status.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste a traceback, terminal error, CUDA OOM or similar failure and want diagnosis and a minimal patch suggestion before any code change. Not for broad refactors.

say_en.text: Here's a traceback — diagnose it first, don't edit code.
What's the root cause of this CUDA OOM? Give the smallest fix only.
Is this shape-mismatch fix a research change?
